headline: SpaceX Makes History in Texas With First Starship Recovery From Orbit
facebook_description: SpaceX recovered Starship from orbit for the first time at its South Texas launch facility Saturday. The spacecraft completed 14 orbits in approximately 22.5 hours and deployed 26 Starlink satellites. However, the Super Heavy booster was lost, leaving full system recovery unachieved. The milestone brings SpaceX closer to a reusable heavy-lift launch system that could lower the cost of orbital transportation, although repeat flights and rapid refurbishment still need to be demonstrated. Could Starship change the economics of space travel? Follow Epic Perspective News for developments. #EPNews #SpaceX #Starship #Texas
